overview.title: A trusted global supplier of high-performance fluoropolymers
overview.description: Shanghai Rongshengke is a leading China-based trading enterprise serving customers worldwide — specialized in PTFE micropowder, PFPE oils, fluoroelastomers and other high-end fluoropolymers. Through deep industry understanding and dedicated focus, we strive to become your trusted supplier in the high-performance polymer field.

who.title: Deep expertise · Quality built on craft
who.description: Our sales and technical team brings decades of hands-on experience in fluoropolymers — proficient in the physical and chemical properties and application scenarios of every fluorine material, with a sharp read on the market and industry trends, enabling forward-looking material recommendations for our customers.

what.title: Diverse grades · Tailored to special needs
what.description: Five product systems covering PTFE micropowder, PFPE oils, FKM/FFKM rubbers, FEP/PFA and PVDF. From standard grades to special custom specifications, we deliver one-stop solutions for the demanding requirements of industrial applications.

where.title: Global reach · Smooth import/export
where.description: Backed by a mature international trade system, we are well-versed in fluoropolymer trade regulations, logistics chains and customs policies — handling sample shipments, orders and global transport efficiently and in full compliance.

productSystem.title: High-end fluoropolymers · 5 product families
productSystem.description: PTFE micropowder, PFPE oils, FKM/FFKM rubbers, FEP/PFA and PVDF — multi-grade, high-quality product lines for the demanding requirements of industrial applications.

a.name: PTFE Micropowder
a.description: Flagship product — precise particle size (D50 1~20 μm), volatiles <0.2%, crystallinity 92~98%, friction coefficient <0.05.
a.uses: Wear-modifying additive in inks and coatings, self-lubricating additive in engineering plastics, release agent in precision electronics.

b.name: PFPE oils / Fluoroelastomers
b.description: Wide-temperature lubrication and corrosion-resistant sealing — PFPE rated −50~300°C+, FKM/FFKM long-term 200°C+ (250°C short-term).
b.uses: Semiconductor vacuum chambers, heavy-load bearings, automotive fuel seals, petrochemical pipe linings.

c.name: FEP / PFA / PVDF
c.description: Melt-processable fluoroplastics — breaking PTFE's non-melt-processable limitation while preserving outstanding thermal and corrosion resistance.
c.uses: High-end cable insulation, semiconductor fluid transport, lithium-battery binders, PV backsheet films.

industries.title: High-end fluoropolymers enabling critical processes across key industries
industries.description: Our fluoropolymer products serve critical processes and extreme-condition components across semiconductor, new energy, automotive, aerospace, chemical and construction industries.

batteries.name: Lithium batteries / New energy
batteries.use: PVDF lithium-grade binders and PV backsheet film — for Li-ion cathode coating, separator coating and PV module backsheet extrusion.

semiconductor.name: Semiconductor / Vacuum equipment
semiconductor.use: PFPE for vacuum-chamber lubrication, FEP/PFA for high-purity fluid transport, PTFE micropowder as precision release agent — covering wafer fab, etch and packaging.

automotive.name: Automotive / Fuel systems
automotive.use: FKM fluoroelastomers in automotive fuel-system seals, O-rings and fuel-line fittings — fuel-resistant, high-temperature, low volume swell.

coatings.name: Coatings / Inks / Engineering plastics
coatings.use: PTFE micropowder for wear-modification in inks and coatings; self-lubricating additive in PA / POM / PPS / PEEK engineering plastics.

construction.name: Construction / Water / Solar
construction.use: PVDF for building-façade fluorocarbon coatings, water-treatment ultrafiltration membranes and PV backsheets — high weatherability, corrosion resistance, long service life.

aerospace.name: Aerospace / Petrochemical
aerospace.use: PFPE for heavy-load bearings and oxygen-environment lubrication, FFKM for aerospace seals, FKM for petrochemical pipe linings — core solutions for extreme service conditions.

whyUs.title: 4 differentiators · Creating value with global customers
whyUs.description: Deep industry expertise · Global trade network · Diverse product matrix — making us a long-term, reliable fluoropolymer partner for our customers.

supply.title: One-stop sourcing
supply.description: Full coverage across PTFE micropowder, PFPE, FKM/FFKM, FEP/PFA and PVDF — one supplier for the entire fluoropolymer sourcing scope, eliminating multi-vendor coordination overhead.

spec.title: Decades of expertise
spec.description: Our sales and technical team understands fluorine materials at the physical-chemistry and application-scenario level — delivering forward-looking material recommendations, not just quotations.

compliance.title: Diverse grades · High quality
compliance.description: Standard, specialty and custom grades — from regular PTFE micropowder to custom-spec PFPE oils, we cover the special-need scenarios most suppliers cannot.

logistics.title: Global trade · Efficient compliance
logistics.description: Deep knowledge of fluoropolymer trade regulations, logistics chains and customs policies — efficient and compliant handling of samples, orders and global shipping for any customer worldwide.

preview.title: Flagship grades at a glance
preview.description: Representative grades from our 5 product families — covering wear modification, wide-temperature lubrication and extreme-condition sealing.

a.name: PTFE micropowder (D50 1~20 μm)
a.description: Precise particle size, low volatiles (<0.2%) and high dispersibility — the go-to additive for ink/coating wear modification and engineering-plastic self-lubrication.

b.name: PFPE perfluoropolyether oil
b.description: Viscosity range 15~1600 cSt — the ultimate lubrication solution for semiconductor vacuum chambers, heavy-load bearings and oxygen-rich environments.

c.name: FKM / FFKM fluoroelastomer
c.description: Standard, specialty low-temp and chemical-resistant raw and compounded rubbers — the preferred choice for automotive fuel, petrochemical and aerospace seals.
